source.text: Business customers repeatedly provide registered address, organization details and ownership information during onboarding even where verified information already exists elsewhere in the bank. The 2027 programme will pre-fill verified company information, reuse approved customer records across onboarding steps, and reduce manual re-keying by relationship managers.

expected_demo_signal: Strong links should emerge to Customer Information Management, Customer Onboarding and Customer; Payment Processing is a distractor. KYC is contextually nearby but not the main subject of this chunk.
